# Budget controls page (`components/accounting/budgets/controls/`)

`/accounting/budgets/controls` (budgets P5-4, spec §5): the bill-approval budget check policy, alert thresholds (company default and per account or slice), the email digest switch, and the overspend alerts with Evaluate now and "last evaluated".

## Files
- `BudgetControlsPage.tsx`: role gating from `useCompany().companyRole` (write roles read; owner/admin edit and see alerts; a viewer gets a sentence). The server re-checks every role.
- `useBudgetControls.ts`: state + writes; a failed refresh keeps the last good data.
- `controlsClient.ts`: fetchers through the registry-typed `call` (`ApiResult`, never throws), `parseThresholds` (1-5 whole % in 1-999, sorted, deduped). Money via `formatMoney`, times via `formatDisplayDateTime` (SAST), as the type-and-money census requires.
- `PolicySettings.tsx`, `ThresholdOverrides.tsx`, `AlertsPanel.tsx` (table from md up, cards below for 390 px).

## Rules
- The email checkbox is OFF and disabled with "Email sending is switched off on this server" while the server's `BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL_ENABLED` is not 1 (`emailAllowedOnServer` on the GET); the PUT refuses it too (409).
- "Last evaluated" older than 36 h, or never, is shown as a warning: the daily timer may not be installed (spec §10).
- Light and dark through the `--ff-*` variables; no browser proof recorded yet.
